bullets: Ming Dynasty opened the season on top with 62 points, the highest score of the gameweek, and the only Bench Boost played in week one.
Bean and Bun finished second on 58, with McCarren Park FC and You're My Wonderwall tied for third on 57.
Show Me The Mane had the roughest opener at 34 points, 28 behind the leader.
Scoring was low and tightly bunched: the league median was 49 and no team cleared 62.
Haaland was the runaway captain pick with 13 of 21 armbands and returned just 2 points, a costly opening call for most of the league.
The highest scoring player owned in this league was M.Sangare of Brentford with 14 points, held by a single manager.
B.Fernandes was the most owned player at 17 of 21 squads and also returned 2 points.
No movement arrows and no transfers this week. Gameweek 1 was the first standings snapshot and everyone was still on their original squad.
